summary:
Astro Curator is an interactive space-exploration experience developed to introduce the challenges of astronaut survival and decision-making during space missions. It places players in the role of an astronaut who must manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, carbon dioxide removal, radiation protection, and power while exploring an unfamiliar planetary environment.

The project addresses the difficulties astronauts may face during long-duration missions, where resources are limited, environmental hazards are present, and communication delays with Earth can make immediate support impossible. Through interactive gameplay, users can explore why resource management, critical thinking, and independent decision-making are essential for space exploration.

Astro Curator is important because it makes complex space-mission challenges more accessible, engaging, and educational. It encourages curiosity about space science while helping users understand the responsibilities and challenges of becoming an astronaut.
details: Astro Curator is an interactive space-exploration experience developed to introduce the challenges of astronaut survival and decision-making during space missions mainly made for users of age 7 -12. It is based on 5 missions to explore each mars and moon which gives user real time experience of space. It will help the kids to learn about space and the survival procedures there easily. We used HTML,CSS, JavaScript, HTML Canvas (2D),SVG. Our project is easy to use for kids and it will leave a good impact on the minds of the kids about space. Our team considered to include all hard things and words about space to present them in a easy manner and easy levels for kids .
